gen-dafont-nordic-outfit: Outfit reads friendly and smooth, its curves stopping short of closing. Nordic packs ancient force into tight, closed shapes with brush-dab spacing, while Outfit does its best work keeping every letter open and approachable.
gen-dafont-nordic-sora: Heavy, ancient, and a bit stubborn: that is Nordic up top. Its closed, cramped letters sit against the widely parted curves of Sora, and that gap between tight and open is what you notice first.
gen-dafont-nordic-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk keeps its letters light and breathing, drawn as ribbon. Beneath the ancient, brush-spaced weight of Nordic, text would move along smoothly, each hollow counter giving the eye somewhere to rest.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-spline-sans: Approachable first, Spline Sans keeps its curves wide open at the ends. Under stretched, technical Nulshock, text would flow with an easy, steady rhythm, every stroke carrying the same weight.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-synonym: Wide-stretched, bold, and unshaded: Nulshock looks like an engineered outline. Synonym lays down a plain stripe of ink with generous openings, a dependable foil for all that spacious width.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-port-lligat-slab: Thin-looking, stretched outlines up top, with traditional lettering waiting underneath. Nulshock is at its best being bold and technical in wide spacing, while Port Lligat Slab does its best work with snug, literary letters.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-quando: Stretched, spacious tracking is the first thing you notice in Nulshock. What stands out most is rope-thin outline strokes sitting over the tall, sparsely spaced, bookish serif letters of Quando.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Round and commanding, Oldtimer draws its forms like open parentheses, with no swell on any downstroke to catch the eye. BioRhyme Expanded handles the refined, bookish work of spacing letters apart.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-copse: Classic and commanding, Oldtimer rounds its forms like open parentheses and keeps every downstroke free of calligraphic swell. Copse adds a literary touch, with visible daylight through every curved opening.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-enriqueta: Enriqueta reads literary and dignified, its chalk-like curves stopping well short of closing. And Oldtimer above it brings round, commanding forms whose horizontal bars weigh exactly what the stems do.
